procs.details: Leave behind a trail of fire dealing fire damage to monsters.
Temporarily increases your cold skill damage and mana replenish.
Unleash a massive anchor swinging around you dealing cold damage.
Temporarily increase your attack damage, attack rating and attack speed.
Summon a dissipating tornado around you that pulls nearby monsters and causes you to dodge all attacks and unleash sand at monsters when they strike you dealing arcane damage.
Conjure a storm cloud at target location striking monsters with surges of lightning dealing lightning damage.
Release a bellowing shout dealing cold damage to all monsters around you and freezing them.

name: Marcher's of Hatred
uniqueEffects: Killing Spree: gain stacks of Movement Speed and Attack Speed after each kill, up to 100 stacks
